idea-plugin.name: LogCraft
idea-plugin.description: A private, local-first log pipeline workbench for Grok, ECS, Logstash, pasted Kafka messages, and safe log sharing inside your JetBrains IDE. Test Grok patterns in batches, review ECS fields, suggest Elasticsearch mappings, inspect Logstash configuration, mask sensitive values, and simulate events without uploading log content or connecting to a backend.
